mapper.sql: WITH version_scope AS ( SELECT v.*, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(v.version_no)) REGEXP '^V[0-9]+([.]0)?$' THEN CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(UPPER(TRIM(v.version_no)),2),'.0','') AS DECIMAL(65,0)) ELSE NULL END AS version_major FROM mes_pro_batch_record_version v WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.deleted = 0 ), report_base AS ( SELECT m.id AS metadata_id, CASE WHEN m.batch_record_name IS NULL OR TRIM(m.batch_record_name) = '' THEN '棘突球囊' ELSE m.batch_record_name END AS batch_record_name, m.batch_record_definition_id, m.batch_record_version_id, m.product_name AS metadata_product_name, m.project_code, (SELECT binding.dcc_project_code_id FROM mes_pro_route_dcc_project_binding binding WHERE binding.route_id = v.route_id AND binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.deleted = 0) AS dcc_project_code_id, v.route_id, v.version_no, v.status AS version_status, v.version_major, CASE UPPER(TRIM(m.form_slot_type)) WHEN 'FORM' THEN 'FORM' WHEN 'LOSS_REPORT' THEN 'LOSS_REPORT' WHEN 'PROCESS_INSPECTION' THEN 'PROCESS_INSPECTION' WHEN 'PARAMETER_RECORD' THEN 'PARAMETER_RECORD' ELSE 'MAIN' END AS form_slot_type, m.route_key, m.source_table_index, m.table_title, j.id AS report_id, j.code AS report_code, j.name AS report_name, m.source_file_name, m.last_import_time, j.update_time FROM mes_pro_batch_record_report m JOIN jimu_report j ON j.id = m.report_id LEFT JOIN version_scope v ON v.id = m.batch_record_version_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted = 0 ), scoped AS ( SELECT r.* FROM report_base r WHERE 1 = 1 AND (${base.sqlSegment}) )

, latest_scoped AS ( SELECT r.* FROM scoped r WHERE 1 = 1 AND r.batch_record_version_id = (SELECT v.id FROM version_scope v WHERE v.definition_id = r.batch_record_definition_id ORDER BY v.version_major DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1) ), route_products AS ( SELECT p.route_id, i.name AS product_name, MIN(p.id) AS product_order FROM mes_pro_route_product p JOIN mes_md_item i ON i.id = p.item_id AND i.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND i.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(i.name) != '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest_scoped s WHERE s.route_id = p.route_id) GROUP BY p.route_id, i.name ), expanded AS ( SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN p.product_order IS NOT NULL THEN p.product_name WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.metadata_product_name,'')) != '' THEN r.metadata_product_name ELSE NULL END AS product_name, COALESCE(p.product_order,0) AS product_order FROM latest_scoped r LEFT JOIN route_products p ON p.route_id = r.route_id ), product_filtered AS ( SELECT r.* FROM expanded r WHERE 1 = 1 AND (${product.sqlSegment}) ), visible_ranked AS ( SELECT r.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.product_name,'')) = '' THEN r.batch_record_name ELSE r.product_name END)), LOWER(TRIM(r.batch_record_name)), LOWER(TRIM(r.form_slot_type)) ORDER BY r.version_major DESC, r.batch_record_version_id DESC) AS visible_rank FROM product_filtered r )
FROM visible_ranked r WHERE 1 = 1 AND r.visible_rank = 1 AND r.batch_record_version_id IS NOT NULL AND (${ew.sqlSegment})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(r.product_name) AS product_name AND r.product_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.product_name) != '' ORDER BY product_name ASC

SELECT v.version_no FROM version_scope v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scoped r WHERE r.batch_record_definition_id = v.definition_id) AND (v.version_major IS NULL OR v.version_major > 2147483647) LIMIT 1
